pieces.Text: If you have performed your daily obedience, by spending 1 minute praying over the corpse of a humanoid opponent or a humanoid who has died a tragic death, you can summon an allip (Bestiary 3 p.12) to serve you. Unlike a normal allip, this allip is of an alignment that matches yours, and has

hit points. It receives a +4 bonus on Will saves to halve the damage from channeled positive energy, and it can't be turned or commanded. This allip serves as a companion to you and can communicate intelligibly with you despite its madness. You can dismiss it as a standard action. If the allip is destroyed or dismissed, you can't summon another for 7 days. This ability allows you to have only one allip companion at a time.
